name: Leto 87-go
source:
A story of friendship, love, and betrayal, where the thin lines between white and black blend together, forming gray - a doomed color. In this story, you will be greeted by two new, unique heroines with their own routes, as well as a protagonist who has nothing to do with the camp. He tries (or doesn't) to realize his true purpose there. What is it really like, this Summer of '87?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2152105095]Steam[/url]]
